description: REPLACES the pool's targets with exactly this list (up to 25): send every target to keep. Each machine must be in the load balancer's private network (connect_vpc first). drain: true stops new connections to a target before maintenance. Scope: network.write.

lb.description: Load balancer id, as returned by list_load_balancers or create_load_balancer.

port.description: Port the service listens on, on the machine's private address.

vm.description: Machine id, as returned by list_vms or create_vm.

name: set_targets
title: Set the targets of a pool
